lines: 1. Mikdui luangna ntam mei nailak khe theithang mu
Tingkao kandi Raguang bampui ram guangtang pukhou
Tingkao kandi gaimei khou neilana ai guang bamni
Tingkao kandi gaimei khou Jisu le bamcham ni
2. LauziuNa nthanmei tei hou puni theithu rui
Nzianmeinun ntamkanmei guai le bamcham ni
Kata thuanku kariu ni khoutei mikkdui keilak khe,
Rianra zaengsimei guai hei nailak khe heikhou tei.
3. Nzianmei guai le ntam meihei naidat lak khe
Rianra zangsipuiram kandih hei naidat lak khe
Lily munpuang puangpui ram tingsaengna bampui kaankhou
Mikdui keimei rianramei guai hei naidat lak khe.
4. Midui rou ntam kanmei nreimei arup nun
Theihmei duipaengram gaimei khoutei bam champuni
Tingsaengzaenga ntamdat makna lungbam puni the
Tingkau ramkhou tingsaengzaeng mbaan thai bampuni.
5. Hei kandi mu rianramei le kaploupui ram e.
Phandui thingna mikdui luangkei loupui bam dei e
Bumaeng kandi gaimei khou neihlaana ai guang bamni
Gaanphiu gaanmei kanloumeipu Guang tupui ramkhou.
6. He nzianmei nun guai le raengbang tat tuandi kho,
Airui phangzau bamni e nzianmei nun guai ta
Khrista rui duanglou kandiu aniu ariu dat maksan,
Naunian mak khang PouRavguangc rui suaihiam lou kandiu
